mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_goods WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM t_goods WHERE deleted = 0 AND id IN #{id}
SELECT * FROM t_goods WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'ONLINE' ORDER BY view_count DESC, favorite_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM t_goods WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'ONLINE' ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_goods (user_id, category_id, title, description, price, original_price, `condition`, cover_image, images, status, stock) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{price}, #{originalPrice}, #{condition}, #{coverImage}, #{images}, #{status}, #{stock})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_goods SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_goods SET reject_reason = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_goods SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE t_goods SET favorite_count = favorite_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE t_goods SET favorite_count = favorite_count - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND favorite_count > 0
UPDATE t_goods SET stock = stock - #{quantity}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND stock >= #{quantity}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_goods WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_goods WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_goods WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = #{status} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT IFNULL(AVG(price), 999999) FROM t_goods WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'ONLINE'
SELECT price FROM t_goods WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'ONLINE' ORDER BY price ASC

SELECT g.id, g.user_id, g.category_id, g.title, g.description, g.price, g.original_price, g.`condition`, g.cover_image, g.images, g.status, g.reject_reason, g.view_count, g.favorite_count, g.stock, g.create_time, IFNULL(u.nickname, u.username) AS username, u.avatar AS userAvatar, u.real_verified AS sellerRealVerified, c.category_name AS categoryName FROM t_goods g LEFT JOIN t_user u ON g.user_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_goods_category c ON g.category_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE g.deleted = 0 AND g.status = 'ONLINE' ORDER BY g.view_count DESC, g.favorite_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT g.id, g.user_id, g.category_id, g.title, g.description, g.price, g.original_price, g.`condition`, g.cover_image, g.images, g.status, g.reject_reason, g.view_count, g.favorite_count, g.stock, g.create_time, IFNULL(u.nickname, u.username) AS username, u.avatar AS userAvatar, u.real_verified AS sellerRealVerified, c.category_name AS categoryName FROM t_goods g LEFT JOIN t_user u ON g.user_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_goods_category c ON g.category_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE g.deleted = 0 AND g.status = 'ONLINE' ORDER BY g.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
